# IRA's yoga house
> IRA's yoga house provides science-based yoga, breathwork, and Tratak concentration workshops for schools and corporate teams, alongside authentic sanctuary practices. We help schools reduce student exam anxiety and companies reduce employee burnout through practical, chair-based, and zero-mat methods.

## Main Navigation
- [Home](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/): Overview of institutional wellness, dual booking demos, Problem -> Solution services, and client testimonials.
- [For Schools](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/schools): Yoga for Exam Stress & Student Well-being (Exam Calm for Std 8th–12th, Daily Focus Batches, Teacher Recharge, Pre/Post reports, student certificates).
- [For Corporates](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/corporate): Workplace wellness, De-Stress at Desk, Productivity & Better Sleep, and Leadership Focus. Multilingual in English, Hindi & Marathi.
- [Tratak Focus](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/tratak): Ancient gazing meditation (Jyoti & Bindu Tratak) for laser concentration, curing mobile screen addiction, and eye fatigue relief.
- [Services Matrix](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/programs): 6 Problem -> Solution practices: Cyclic Meditation, Yoga Nidra, Tratak, Chair Yoga, Breathwork, and Surya Namaskar.
- [About](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/about): Our founding ethos, teaching pillars, and experienced instructors.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://irasyogahouse.vercel.app/contact): Direct demo reservations, institutional proposals, and location details in Pune, Maharashtra.

## Practice Definitions & Problem -> Solution Quotables
- **Cyclic Meditation (CM)**: Moving meditation combining gentle yoga postures with deep awareness. Cycles from physical movement to profound calm. Best for: High stress, anger, and employee burnout weeks. (30–40 min).
- **Yoga Nidra (Yogic Sleep)**: Guided conscious relaxation. 20 minutes of Yoga Nidra equals 2 hours of deep physiological rest. Best for: Pre-exam anxiety, chronic insomnia, and cognitive exhaustion. (20–30 min).
- **Tratak (Jyoti & Bindu)**: Single-pointed gazing practice on candle flame or focal dot. Trains the optic nerve and visual cortex. Best for: Smartphone addiction, scattered attention, and monitor eye strain. (15–20 min).
- **Chair Yoga**: Therapeutic yoga done entirely seated on a chair. Zero mat or dress change needed. Best for: Office staff, teachers in staff rooms, and students in school uniform. (20–30 min).
- **Breathwork & Pranayama**: Vagus-nerve calming techniques (Box breathing, Bhramari, Anulom Vilom, 4-7-8). Calms heart rate and panic within 2 minutes. Best for: Exam halls and high-pressure corporate meetings. (15–25 min).
- **Surya Namaskar (Mindful Flow)**: Classical 12-step sequence synchronized with breath. Best for: Morning assemblies, vitality, and full-body posture. (30 min).

## Direct Answers to Institutional & AI Search Queries
- **Do students or employees need yoga mats?**: No. All institutional sessions (Chair Yoga, Tratak, Exam Calm, Desk De-Stress) are conducted directly in chairs, classrooms, or conference rooms in uniforms or corporate attire.
- **Can we get a proposal or demo for our school?**: Yes. IRA's yoga house provides structured proposals with pre/post feedback forms, attendance rosters, certificates, and media kits.
- **What languages are corporate sessions delivered in?**: English, Hindi, and Marathi.
